messages:
sara: New tenant onboarding for ap-northeast-6. Need quota lift for p5/p4d/g5 and ENIs. Target start next Wed. Details:

mike: which account id and region? can you paste numbers?

sara: acct-789012345678, region ap-northeast-6. Requesting:
- p5 instances: 4
- p4d.24xlarge: 2 (eval infra)
- g5.12xlarge: 10 (inference pool + burst)
- EC2 ENI quota bump to 250
- Elastic IPs 50

toni: filing support case now. will ask for burst allocation + cross-account entitlement so org can use existing reserved pool.

cloud-bot: Support case created: SR-2026-0318-9876. AWS rep: H. Sato. ETA initial response 24h.

anne: FYI subnet size needs /24 to place p4d + p5 with placement groups. current VPC is /27 so we'll run out of IPs. need to expand or carve new VPC.

raj: Is this for Dedicated or Hosted? costs differ a lot if we reserve vs use spot.

sara: mix: p4d reserved for eval (2), p5/g5 mostly spot + on-demand burst. estimate monthly delta ~$48k if reserved for baseline, otherwise spot expected ~60% saving but higher preemption risk.

mike: Toni — can you also request ENI ephemeral increase and NAT gateway throughput? past onboarding hit NAT egress caps.

toni: added NAT GW throughput to SR and asked for increased secondary ENIs per instance. pasted the AWS CLI we used to check quotas:

```
aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-1216C47A
```

infra-oncall: tagging note: when provisioning, use tag 'team:tenant-x' + 'env:prod' so billing maps correctly. Also ensure Security team signs off on inbound port openings for model-telemetry.

sara: Thanks. I'll queue a canary rollout for model-serving on dedicated g5s once quotas are live. ping me when SR is updated. :thumbsup:
